solution_principle: When referencing multiple points from Rhino, their order may not match the desired curve path. Sort Along Curve reorders points based on their position along a reference curve. removeDuplicatePts eliminates coincident points that cause zero-length segments. Both are essential cleanup steps before creating curves from referenced geometry.
